value.rationale: An entire cyclic difference distribution of the natural square-image set is classified for every odd modulus, resolving all singular and unit-shift strata. The contrast of square and nonsquare shifts reverses sharply at all odd primes p=1 mod 4 upon lifting from modulus p to p^2, and persists at every higher power; this motivated phenomenon is not the classical prime-field special case or a numerical table.
